title: Balans: bosslar kuchaydi
text: Ritsarning Ufq kesimi bossga ko'proq zarar beradi. Qor Malikasi va O'rmon Shohi ancha kuchliroq — endi ularni yengish qiyin. Birinchi dunyo Iblisi o'zgarmadi.

steps.eval: const E = g.enemies[0].constructor; for (const [k, x, y] of [['rammer', 86, 92], ['archer', 262, 72], ['wisp', 202, 204], ['blob', 68, 192], ['rammer', 252, 182], ['wisp', 122, 62], ['blob', 150, 222]]) { const e = new E(k, x, y); e.spawn = 0; e.speedMul = 0.4; g.enemies.push(e); } g.player.fx = 1; g.player.fy = 0;
